sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, who sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach's broader form has been strong (W-W-D-W-L across their last five), and they'll be heavy favourites against Alsager, who occupy bottom spot with just 4 points and a concerning run of five losses in their last six matches.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town in a match between mid-table sides, with Stafford looking to bounce back from their own recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table and unbeaten in five before their last two defeats, welcome Eccleshall (6th place, currently on a winning streak). Wolverhampton Casuals travel to Wednesfield Community in a fixture between mid-pack rivals, while high-flying Bilston Town host Foley Meir in a top-half clash. Barnton, in 7th and on two straight wins, face Shawbury United—who are in freefall with six consecutive defeats. Brereton Social (14th, struggling with recent losses) play host to Widnes Town (bottom, pointless), and Market Drayton Town welcome New Mills in a battle involving teams with inconsistent form. Crewe entertain Allscott Heath (12th), and Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town (18th, also near the bottom). A midweek fixture on Wednesday 7 October sees Brereton Social hosting Wednesfield Community at 19:45.
